title: 349 Needlerush Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 349 Needlerush Drive is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:-WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum allotted wristband qty is 12)-6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental-6 Passenger Electric Cart Included in Rental-Parking for 3 Vehicles (garage access not available)-Natural Gas Grill-Exterior Shower-Private Pool and Spa (complimentary pool heating available October 1-May 1) -Multiple Screened Porches-2 Fireplaces-4 King Bedrooms-3 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Camp Watercolor-9 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Watercolor Beach Club Access-9 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Discover the essence of coastal living at 349 Needlerush Drive, beautifully nestled in WaterColor’s Lake District. This stunning home welcomes you with twelve-foot ceilings, exposed wood beams, and custom trim, creating an inviting, upscale atmosphere. Step into the gourmet kitchen, adorned with a striking blue backsplash, granite countertops, and premium appliances, including a Sub-Zero refrigerator and gas stove. The oversized island seats seven comfortably, perfect for sharing meals and laughter with loved ones. Relax in the spacious living room, featuring plush sofas and a cozy white gas fireplace, or head out to the screened porch to unwind by the wood-burning fireplace. Here, you'll also find an outdoor grill, comfy couches, and a breakfast table overlooking a private pool—ideal for enjoying the serene outdoors. The first-floor guest bedroom, complete with a king bed and private bath, offers added comfort and convenience. Upstairs, the master suite awaits with a king bed, sitting area, luxurious soaking tub, and access to a private porch. Two additional king bedrooms with en-suites open onto a sprawling balcony, complete with surf-inspired seating and a swinging daybed. A cozy bunkroom with built-in bunks rounds out this floor. The third-floor retreat features a second living area with four twin beds, a video game setup, and a queen bed offering views of the WaterColor woodlands. A spacious bath and a room with a ping-pong table complete this level, with a spiral staircase leading to a fourth-floor cupola—a perfect spot for panoramic views and unforgettable sunsets. With a 6-passenger golf cart included, cruise WaterColor’s pools and beach club with ease. Be among the first to create lasting memories at 349 Needlerush Drive—a destination where relaxation and coastal beauty await. FIRST FLOOR:-Living/Dining Room-Kitchen-Half Bath-Laundry Room-Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower SECOND FLOOR:-Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower & Soaking Tub + Private Balcony Access-Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower + Shared Balcony Access-Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower + Shared Balcony Access -Bunkroom: 2 Sets of Twin Bunk Beds (4)-Laundry Room THIRD FLOOR:-Open 2nd Living Area: 4 Twin Beds (4) + 1 Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower-Private Ping Pong Room Fourth Floor:-Viewing Tower + Sitting Area
